title: Nice bases for Lie algebras
summary: The concept of a nice basis for a Lie algebra was introduced to study the Ricci curvature on nilpotent Lie groups equipped with a left-invariant metric. Despite the many applications in differential geometry, for example in the construction of Einstein manifolds, very little is known about the existence and number of nice bases on a given Lie algebra. This paper studies this question for three classes of Lie algebras, namely direct sums, almost abelian ones and nilpotent Lie algebras associated to a graph.
